title: Ndwandwe–Zulu War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Ndwandwe–Zulu War", at revision 1370629469, opens: "The Ndwandwe–Zulu War of 1817–1819 was a war fought between the expanding Zulu Kingdom and the Ndwandwe tribe in South Africa." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q9294875, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict between the Zulu Kingdom and the Ndwandwe". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
